products.title: Rewind2 Wireless Retro Headphones Black

description.html: The Rewind 2 Wireless Retro Headphones Black are wireless headphones with a retro design and modern connectivity, built around Bluetooth multipoint and wireless share mode. They ship with orange and black foam earmuffs. Bluetooth multipoint keeps the headphones connected to two devices at once, and wireless share mode lets a second pair of Rewind 2 headphones join the same audio source, so two people can listen to the same music without a splitter cable. A single built-in microphone handles calls, and Google Fast Pair speeds up initial setup on Android devices. Sound can be tuned through 3 EQ presets via the JLab App, which also manages custom controls, music and movie mode switching, safe hearing limits, and over-the-air firmware updates. The headphones connect over Bluetooth 5.4 with SBC and AAC codec support and a 30+ foot range, supporting the HSP, HFP, A2DP, and AVRCP protocols. Latency runs under 200ms in Movie Mode and over 200ms in Music mode. The headphones weigh 56.8 grams and measure 6.1 inches tall, 5.12 inches long, and 1.18 inches wide. Two sets of foam earmuffs, one orange and one black, are included so the look can be swapped to match an outfit or mood. Battery life is rated at 20 hours per charge, with a 3 hour charge time and a quick charge option that adds 3 hours of playtime from a 10 minute charge. Standby time is rated at 300+ hours. Includes: Rewind 2 Wireless headphones, orange and black foam earmuffs, and a JLab 2 year limited warranty. products.title: JBuds Lux ANC Headphones Sage

description.html: JLab JBuds Lux ANC in Sage are over-ear wireless headphones built without compromise on the things that matter most. Hybrid ANC, 70 hours of playtime, Spatial Audio, and a foldable design that handles the desk, the commute, and the gym without skipping a beat. Hybrid ANC reduces ambient noise by up to 35dB using both feedforward and feedback microphones. Five condenser microphones with 3-mic ENC handle call clarity. Be Aware Mode switches off ANC when you need to hear your surroundings. Spatial Audio creates a wider, more immersive soundstage. Wireless Share Mode lets two pairs of JBuds Lux ANC headphones share audio from one device simultaneously, no splitter needed. Battery life sits at 70 total hours with ANC off (40 hours with ANC on), with 40 hours of talk time. Quick charge gives you 7.5 hours from 10 minutes of charging. The included USB-C to C cable also supports wired audio playback. Faux leather ear cushions. Foldable design. Button controls. Bluetooth 5.4 with SBC and AAC codecs. Google Fast Pair for instant Android pairing. Multipoint connects two devices simultaneously. Support protocols: HSP/HFP/A2DP/AVRCP. Compatible with iOS and Android, including Siri and Google Assistant. Movie Mode latency under 200ms. The JLab app adds custom EQ, control remapping, noise control, Interval Timer, OTA firmware updates, safe hearing tools, and My JLab device management. Includes JBuds Lux ANC headphones, USB-C charging and audio cable, and a JLab 2-year limited warranty. products.title: Go Lux ANC Wireless Headphones Sage

description.html: JLab GO Lux ANC in Sage are over-ear wireless headphones with active noise cancellation, the starting point in the JLab headphone range designed to deliver reliable ANC performance without overcomplicating things. They sit below the JBuds Lux ANC and bring hybrid ANC, Spatial Audio, Multipoint, and 70 total hours of playtime at an accessible price point. Hybrid ANC reduces ambient noise by up to 30dB using both feedforward and feedback microphones working together. Five MEMS microphones with 3-mic ENC handle both noise cancellation and call clarity. Be Aware Mode switches off ANC and lets in surrounding sound when you need to stay alert. Spatial Audio creates a wider, more immersive soundstage. EQ3 Sound gives you three preset listening modes: Signature, Bass Boost, and Balanced. Battery life sits at 70 total hours with ANC off (40 hours with ANC on) and 40 hours of talk time, with standby exceeding 400 hours. Quick charge gives you 7 hours of playback from 10 minutes of charging. Charges via USB-C in 2.5 hours. Bluetooth 5.4 with SBC and AAC codecs. Both Google Fast Pair and Microsoft Swift Pair supported for instant pairing on Android and Windows devices. Multipoint connects to two devices simultaneously. Support protocols: HSP/HFP/A2DP/AVRCP. Compatible with iOS and Android, including Siri and Google Assistant. Movie Mode latency under 200ms for synced video. Wireless Share Mode lets two JLab headphones connect to the same audio source simultaneously - useful for travel or shared listening without splitting a cable or needing two devices. Faux leather ear cushions for a soft, comfortable seal during extended listening. Foldable design for easy packing and storage. Button controls for playback and calls. The JLab app adds custom EQ, control remapping, Music and Movie modes, noise control settings, OTA firmware updates, safe hearing tools, and My JLab device management. Includes GO Lux ANC headphones and a JLab 2-year limited warranty.
